`resetall
`timescale 1ns / 1ps
`default_nettype none

module priority_encoder #(
    parameter WIDTH = 4,
    parameter LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY = 0
)(
    input wire [WIDTH-1:0] input_unencoded,
    output wire output_valid,
    output wire [$clog2(WIDTH)-1:0] output_encoded,
    output wire [WIDTH-1:0] output_unencoded
);

parameter LEVELS = WIDTH > 2 ? $clog2(WIDTH) : 1;
parameter W = 2**LEVELS;

generate
    if (WIDTH == 256 && LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY == 0 && LEVELS == 8 && W == 256) begin : fast_256
        wire [15:0] group_valid;
        wire [15:0] group_enable;
        wire [15:0] group_winner;
        wire [255:0] selected;
        wire [15:0] encoded_plane [3:0];
        wire [15:0] upper_plane [3:0];
        genvar g, i, b;

        for (g = 0; g < 16; g = g + 1) begin : groups
            wire [15:0] x;
            wire [15:0] winner;
            wire [3:0] local_encoded;
            wire [15:0] local_plane [3:0];
            assign x = input_unencoded[g*16 +: 16];
            assign group_valid[g] = |x;
            if (g == 15) begin : top_group
                assign group_enable[g] = 1'b1;
            end else begin : other_group
                assign group_enable[g] = ~(|group_valid[15:g+1]);
            end
            assign group_winner[g] = group_valid[g] & group_enable[g];

            for (i = 0; i < 16; i = i + 1) begin : bits_in_group
                if (i == 15) begin : top_bit
                    assign winner[i] = x[i];
                end else begin : other_bit
                    assign winner[i] = x[i] & ~(|x[15:i+1]);
                end
                assign selected[g*16+i] = winner[i] & group_enable[g];
                for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : local_encoding_planes
                    if ((i & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included
                        assign local_plane[b][i] = winner[i];
                    end else begin : excluded
                        assign local_plane[b][i] = 1'b0;
                    end
                end
            end

            for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : encoding
                if (b == 3) begin : high_local_bit
                    assign local_encoded[b] = |x[15:8];
                end else begin : low_local_bit
                    assign local_encoded[b] = |local_plane[b];
                end
                assign encoded_plane[b][g] = local_encoded[b] & group_enable[g];
                if ((g & (1 << b)) != 0) begin : included_group
                    assign upper_plane[b][g] = group_winner[g];
                end else begin : excluded_group
                    assign upper_plane[b][g] = 1'b0;
                end
            end
        end

        for (b = 0; b < 4; b = b + 1) begin : output_encoding
            assign output_encoded[b] = |encoded_plane[b];
            if (b == 3) begin : high_group_bit
                assign output_encoded[b+4] = |group_valid[15:8];
            end else begin : low_group_bit
                assign output_encoded[b+4] = |upper_plane[b];
            end
        end

        assign output_valid = |group_valid;
        assign output_unencoded[255:1] = selected[255:1];
        assign output_unencoded[0] = selected[0] | ~output_valid;
    end else begin : original_parameters
        wire [W-1:0] input_padded;
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_valid [LEVELS-1:0];
        wire [W/2-1:0] stage_enc [LEVELS-1:0];
        assign input_padded = {{W-WIDTH{1'b0}}, input_unencoded};
        genvar l, n;
        for (n = 0; n < W/2; n = n + 1) begin : loop_in
            assign stage_valid[0][n] = |input_padded[n*2+1:n*2];
            if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = !input_padded[n*2];
            end else begin : msb
                assign stage_enc[0][n] = input_padded[n*2+1];
            end
        end
        for (l = 1; l < LEVELS; l = l + 1) begin : loop_levels
            for (n = 0; n < W/(2*2**l); n = n + 1) begin : loop_compress
                assign stage_valid[l][n] = |stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1:n*2];
                if (LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY) begin : lsb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2] ?
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]} :
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]};
                end else begin : msb
                    assign stage_enc[l][(n+1)*(l+1)-1:n*(l+1)] =
                        stage_valid[l-1][n*2+1] ?
                        {1'b1, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+2)*l-1:(n*2+1)*l]} :
                        {1'b0, stage_enc[l-1][(n*2+1)*l-1:(n*2)*l]};
                end
            end
        end
        assign output_valid = stage_valid[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_encoded = stage_enc[LEVELS-1];
        assign output_unencoded = 1 << output_encoded;
    end
endgenerate
endmodule

`resetall
",
  "bottleneck": "The original implementation propagates encoded bits through an eight-level binary priority hierarchy, then decodes the resulting index to generate the 256-bit one-hot output. That serial encode-then-decode dependency is a likely maximum-arrival bottleneck.",
  "rewrite": "Specialize the requested instance into sixteen 16-bit groups. Compute local highest-set-bit masks and higher-group exclusion masks in parallel. Generate one-hot outputs directly from those masks, and form the binary index using parallel masked OR planes rather than a full-width priority mux tree. Retain the original implementation for other parameter settings.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Expected to reduce maximum arrival by eliminating the binary-index-to-one-hot decode dependency and shortening encoded-data selection. No numerical gain is claimed: the supplied mapping flow has not been run, so timing improvement and electrical compliance remain to be measured.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Adds parallel local exclusion and encoding logic while removing the specialized instance's variable-shift decoder. Sharing of reduction terms and buffering of group-enable signals will determine mapped area. Compliance with the 8862.124480 um^2 cap is not established without mapping.",
  "functional_boundaries": "For WIDTH=256 and LSB_HIGH_PRIORITY=0, every nonzero two-state input selects its highest asserted bit; output_encoded is that bit's index and output_valid is one. For an all-zero input, output_valid is zero, output_encoded is zero, and output_unencoded is 256'b1, preserving the original default behavior. Ports, parameter defaults, LEVELS and W parameters, and output widths are retained. Other parameter settings use the original logic. The design is combinational Verilog-2001 with no storage, latency, includes, or external dependencies. Mapped equivalence and zero electrical violations still require tool verification."
}
